subject: Draft AWS listing copy + value props / technical snippets review
messages:
From: Mike Horton <mike.horton@acmeanalytics.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-12T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Draft AWS listing copy + quick pricing Q

Kimberly / Marissa,

Thanks again for the earlier call. Attached is our first-pass AWS Marketplace listing draft (acme_listing_draft.docx). We tried to capture the value props and a short technical snippets section, but would love Redwood's feedback on two things:

- Hero headline & 1-line value proposition (does it map to co-sell messaging?)
- Technical snippets (AMI/AMI install vs container guidance — we want to avoid confusing customers)
- Pricing phrasing / meter language (we currently say "usage-based per inference" which may be too vague)

Can you take a look and flag anything that would block co-sell eligibility? If easier, happy to do a 30-min walkthrough next week.

Attachments: acme_listing_draft.docx

Best,
Mike Horton
Head of Partnerships, Acme Analytics
mike.horton@acmeanalytics.com
+1 (415) 555-0199

From: kimberly.park@redwood.com <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Mike Horton <mike.horton@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-12T17:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft AWS listing copy + quick pricing Q

Mike — thanks for the draft. Quick read-through below and we can tighten on a call if useful. High-level notes: 

- Hero / one-liner: simplify to customer outcome ("Predictable LLM inference at cloud scale") — avoid model-centric language.
- Technical snippets: split into two compact bullets: AMI install steps (one-liner) + container/marketplace usage (one-liner). AWS buyers scan for AMI vs SaaS clarity.
- Pricing copy: suggest replacing "per inference" with "per 1k tokens rendered" or a clear unit tied to the SKU; include a pricing footnote for region/instance uplift.
- Entitlement & SKU callouts: provide SKU mapping + recommended SKUs for trial vs production.

I've attached our internal review template (aws_listing_review_template.xlsx) with recommended fields filled. Ben / Aditya / Marissa — any strong objections or must-haves before we send edits back to Acme? Goal: make edits that preserve their voice but unblock co-sell and AMI clarity.

Thanks,
Kim Park
Marketplace GTM Lead | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com

Attachment: aws_listing_review_template.xlsx

From: ben.carter@redwood.com <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-13T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft AWS listing copy + quick pricing Q

On Thu, Aug 12, 2026 at 5:20 PM kimberly.park@redwood.com wrote:
> Mike — thanks for the draft. Quick read-through below and we can tighten on a call if useful.

Adding concrete copy edits (first pass):

- Hero headline (current): "Low-latency LLM inference for analytics teams"
  -> Replace with: "Deploy fast, predictable LLM inference — no ops overhead"

- Three short value bullets (20–40 chars each):
  * "100ms p95 inference with autoscaling"
  * "Pay per 1k tokens, predictable billing"
  * "Private deployment options: VPC & on-prem"

- Technical snippets section (new structure):
  1) "AMI: single-click deploy + pre-baked runtime—ideal for isolated/private infra."
  2) "Marketplace container: integrates with EKS, ideal for high-throughput SaaS."

- Pricing footnote: "List price excludes region-specific instance cost; see SKU matrix for exact uplift."

These keep it concise and AWS-friendly. I can draft inline edits into acme_listing_draft.docx and send v2 if that helps.

Ben
Sr Product Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference

From: marissa.cole@redwood.com <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Mike Horton <mike.horton@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-15T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Consolidated AWS listing copy edits (sweep attached)

Mike — thanks for the quick turnaround. We're attaching a consolidated sweep with proposed edits and a SKU mapping CSV to make publication straightforward. Key points: 

- We kept your core messaging but tightened the hero and added three short benefit bullets (see acme_listing_v4.docx).
- Added clear AMI vs container usage guidance in the "Technical Details" section.
- Attached sku_mapping.csv with recommended trial vs production SKUs and suggested pricing footnotes.

Timeline request: to hit your target AWS publication window, can you confirm these edits (or suggest quick changes) by COB Aug 17? After you sign off we'll: 
1) upload final doc to AWS Seller Console,
2) confirm AMI tagging & Seller ID with the marketplace team,
3) open co-sell enablement request (if you want co-sell).

Attachments: acme_listing_v4.docx, sku_mapping.csv

Thanks — happy to jump on a 20-min call tomorrow if you want us to walk through the changes.

—Marissa
Sr. GTM Programs Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Mike Horton <mike.horton@acmeanalytics.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, kimberly.park@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-18T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Consolidated AWS listing copy edits (sweep attached)

Thanks everyone — these edits look great and align with what our customers have asked for. A couple of small asks before final: 

- Can we soften the "100ms p95" claim to "~100ms p95 on typical configs" to avoid hard SLA language?
- Regional pricing callout: please make the pricing footnote explicit about EU uplift — our finance team flagged that.

We approve acme_listing_v4.docx with those two tweaks. Marissa — please proceed with the upload and let me know when you open the co-sell request; we'll need any templates/ops info from AWS to complete that. Happy to hop on a quick call if that helps.

Best,
Mike Horton
Head of Partnerships, Acme Analytics
